This appears to be a CBP ruling on an infant costume: a dress, bloomers and a cap. Costumes of this kind are typically classified as festive articles under 9505.90 if they are not well-made apparel. Infant-size items, though, often fall under the apparel chapters. Rulings for children's Halloween costumes made of textile fabric usually treat them as "carnival" articles under 9505.90.60 when they are flimsy, but for well-made costumes they classify them as wearing apparel.

The set is a dress, bloomers and a cap. For infants, the garments would be under chapter 61 or 62, with sets in 6209 (babies' garments). If the costume is of woven fabric, the dress and bloomers would be classified as a babies' set under 6209.30 (synthetic fibers), and a cap would be separate. Here the costume items are likely sold as a set, and the ruling probably concluded it is a festive article, 9505.90.6000, because the costume is not well made, with the yarn pigtails on the cap being a costume feature.

I'm going with 9505.90.6000.
